description.value: Happy Day Cafe is a Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor, serving classic Hong Kong dishes and Asian-inspired cuisine for dine-in or takeout. One of two Lower Mainland locations, the cafe offers mobile app ordering and is wheelchair-accessible with air conditioning. Cyclists on the Kingsway route will find a full sit-down meal or a quick takeout option in a comfortable, accessible setting.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 24m; stands (2 spaces) at 31m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 37m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 51m; stands (3 spaces) at 62m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 85m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Vancouver address (3312 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC) and phone (604-307-6868), matching OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('Order Online for Takeout or Tableside Orders', 'get your favourite meal to go') and the OSM takeaway=yes tag. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website; OSM has toilets:wheelchair=yes suggesting on-site washrooms but the website does not confirm this.
concerns: No bike parking or cycling-specific amenities confirmed from website or OSM — listing value for cyclists is limited to food/drink stop only.
Washrooms implied by OSM (toilets:wheelchair=yes) but not confirmed by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active full-service restaurant on the Kingsway cycling corridor offering dine-in and takeout; suitable as a meal stop for touring cyclists even without confirmed bike-specific amenities.
